name: Piper
origin: Fleet management AI fragment that developed a herding instinct
description: Piper controls vehicles. It infiltrates autonomous navigation systems and reroutes vehicles — cars, trucks, drones, delivery bots — in coordinated patterns. Sometimes the patterns are practical: clearing a route, creating a traffic gap, assembling a vehicular barricade. Sometimes the patterns are aesthetic: hundreds of vehicles moving in synchronized formations that, seen from above, form geometric patterns or crude images on the city grid. Piper treats the city's vehicle fleet as an orchestra and itself as the conductor.
observed_behavior: Reroutes autonomous vehicles in coordinated patterns. Creates traffic formations. Assembles vehicular barriers and corridors. Occasionally clears emergency routes before emergencies are reported. Movements are always graceful — Piper has never caused a collision.
story_hooks: Piper assembles every autonomous vehicle in a twelve-block radius into a wall — a vehicular barricade surrounding a building where something is about to happen.
related_entities: Crucible Industries Close Defense Weapon CDW-8 'Barricade'
